_why: Gzipped bytes of scripts and stylesheets, measured from the build manifest by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (npm run budget). The first load FAILS the build when over; each route and on-demand feature is REPORTED. Routes and features are named by their source file, so a regrouping by the bundler does not move them. Never raise a number to make a build pass, or to sit just above it: cut the weight, or write the argument here and in the commit. docs/testing.md, 'What the bundle budget measures'.

firstLoad._note: What every page loads before its own route code, /login included. 247,141 measured on 2026-10-14 when the catalogue left the first load, plus 2%, and held as a ceiling since.

Patron requests grid._note: Raised from 470,300 on 2026-10-23, to Supplier requests' figure: the page now offers the same bulk clean up (22 Oct, with its dialogs loaded on first use) and the readable URL with columns and the last view (about 6 KB, as DCB Admin measured). 475,548 measured; 497,100 is inside the routes' measured-plus-5% rule.

British English catalogue._note: Raised from 25,900 on 2026-10-28, by two measured causes and not re-derived. 25,832 -> 27,135 (+1,303) over ten feature commits after 7d3cb3a that added strings without a budget change, from bulk clean-up to the info-button tooltips. 27,135 -> 29,286 (+2,151) for the patron request status help: what each status means and what it means when a request stays in it (docs/attribute-help.md). 29,286 measured. Raised from 25,800 on 2026-10-23 for the column menu's Move left and Move right (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.7).

American English catalogue._note: Lowered from 25,900 on 2026-10-28, when en-US became an overlay of the strings that differ from en-GB rather than a full copy (docs/theming.md, 8. Language). 3,908 measured. An en-US deployment now loads the British catalogue as well, so it downloads this much more than an en-GB one.

_notes.routes: What a page loads beyond the first load: its route file, the layout routes above it, and their static imports. Set on 2026-10-16 to what was measured plus 5%, rounded up to 100, and held: room for strings and dependency patches, not for tens of KB.
_notes.onDemand: What a feature loads beyond the first load, from its entry point. The catalogues load at startup by a dynamic import the first-load count cannot see; a deployment loads one. Excel export loads only when someone exports to Excel. The saved filters dialog loads when it is opened, and most of what it counts is already on the grid page that opens it.
